reason: A DeepSeek Harness WebUI plugin that provides customizable keyboard shortcuts for session, interface, model, clipboard, system, and host permission controls.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness WebUI 提供可录制、可禁用并带冲突检测的自定义键盘快捷键，以快速操作会话、界面、模型和权限设置。
summaries.en: Provides customizable, recordable keyboard shortcuts with conflict detection for DeepSeek Harness WebUI sessions, interface controls, models, and permission settings.

capabilities: Captures and dispatches customizable keyboard shortcuts in the DSH WebUI
Controls supported session, view, model, clipboard, theme, language, and fullscreen actions
Stores shortcut configuration in browser localStorage
Switches host permission presets through a host-side service route
